name: Clone My Post
author: Bss

sections.description:
Clone Posts and Pages easily. Duplicate your pages, posts saving time. Preset all new cloned post with the prelesected status (draft, private, public, pending).

Plugin : Homepage
If you like this plugin, please rate and review.
If you have any question, suggestion or issue, please post here.

How to use

  1. First Activate Plugin.
  2. Go Select to Duplicate Page settings Menu from Settings Tab and savings settings.
  3. Then Create New Post/Page or Use old.
  4. After click on duplicate this link, then duplicate post/ page will be created and saved as draft,publish,pending,private depending upon settings.

Clone My Post Pro additional options

  • **Add prefix to the cloned title.
  • **Add suffix to the cloned title.
  • **choose which roles are enabled to clone posts
  • **Future Upgrade and Support
sections.installation:
1. Upload the duplicate-page folder to the directory /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin using the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
